item.title: US military preparing for potentially weeks-long Iran operations
item.description: WASHINGTON (Reuters) — The U.S. military is preparing for the possibility of sustained, weeks-long operations against Iran if President Donald Trump orders an attack, two U.S. officials told Reuters, in what could become a far more serious conflict than previously seen between the countries.
